entities.name: Lucius Marcius Philippus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucius Marcius Philippus was a politician and senator in the late Roman republic. He was governor of Syria from 61 to 60 and later served in the consulship of 56 BC. He was also step-father of the emperor Augustus.
